news.title:
ACC Ltd's board approved audited financial results for FY26 and recommended a dividend of Rs. 7.50 per equity share, subject to shareholder approval.
The company appointed P.M. Nanabhoy & Co. as cost auditors and Grant Thornton Bharat LLP as internal auditors for FY27.
